disambiguation: It is a visualizer and observability toy, not a vault, note store, or memory/RAG system.
extras: Requires manual installation and building of the plugin.
intentEvidence: It animates Obsidian's native graph view: nodes flash as Claude Code reads and edits the notes in your vault.
problem: Users lack a visual way to see which notes or files an AI agent is reading or modifying within the vault.
summary: Neural Vault animates Obsidian's graph view, causing nodes to flash and drift based on activity detected by Claude Code.
